summary: Multi-tenant refonte (superadmin, tenants, users, audit, isolation) validated end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest tests pass, and full Playwright walkthrough of superadmin -> tenant switcher -> business tabs -> regression as admin@logitrak succeeded. Data isolation between tenants confirmed at API level (admin-b@test.ch sees 0 Logitrak fines/users, 404 on direct fine access). Regression: admin@logitrak still sees 5 fines and dashboard with 4627 trips.

issues: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' repeated ~4x — likely missing/duplicate `key` prop in DashboardPage table (POLICE 56974 has no plate, empty key). Non-blocking but should be fixed.
A11y warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (tenant create/edit modal). Non-blocking.
wss://.../api/livre/realtime fails to connect after login (WebSocket closed before connection established). Preview env limitation but should be verified.

action_items: Optional: fix duplicate React key warning in DashboardPage synthesis table (use vehicle_id/driver_id fallback instead of plate).
Optional: add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to tenant create/edit dialog.
Optional: cleanup script for leftover TEST_Tenant_* tenants (2 remain from run) — tests intentionally don't delete since no DELETE tenant endpoint exists.
Confirm WebSocket /api/livre/realtime works in production (ws upgrade behind preview ingress may block it).
critical_code_review_comments: TenantSwitcher stores tenant in localStorage and uses window.location.assign — hard reload each switch is intentional to reset all in-memory caches, good.
admin.py DELETE /tenants endpoint is missing — only PATCH status=suspended is supported. Deliberate (data preservation) but worth documenting.
list_tenants stats iterate one collection at a time (N tenants × 4 counts): fine for now, could be batched.
require_superadmin has no logging of 403 attempts — consider log_audit('admin.forbidden').
seed_data_creation: Created & left behind 2 tenants TEST_Tenant_cb5a9c_edited and TEST_Tenant_c6410f_edited (from tenant create+edit test). Also created + deleted transient test users. Logitrak/Client Test B data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-tenant feature is stable. Main test file: /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py. Frontend has cosmetic React key warning in dashboard table (non-blocking). Realtime WS may not connect through preview ingress — verify separately. Test tenants named TEST_Tenant_* linger since no DELETE endpoint; ignore or clean via Mongo directly.
